biography:
Experienced BIM 3D Design Manager, Pre-Construction Specialist and Local 134 IBEW Electrician/Journeyman and Foreman. 

As a Project Manager, I work to develop and implement strategies and plans to ensure project teams exceed contractual and financial commitments to deliver efficient electrical design.

Extract from over 10 years of hands-on, technical field experience to implement 3D electrical design which proactively minimizes risk thereby increasing job productivity and profitability.
 
I have prior experience collaborating with a team of design specialists, field personnel as well as multiple trades to design complex electrical systems for multiple floors of Palos Hospital, Digital Reality Data Center and Red Square Data Center (Time Warner Cable) using Revit MEP and Navisworks. 

Other Strengths: Strong sense of leadership, Ability to anticipate and adapt to obstacles; Excellent problem solving skills; Commitment to continued learning; Proficient in AutoCAD MEP, Revit MEP, Navisworks, Accubid and Blue Beam; Experience leading crews of 10-15 electricians, providing them with installation instructions, materials and direction to exceed budgeted productivity goals.
